description: JIT dead code elimination pass drops function calls with unused return values, deleting required external side-effects.
spec_notes: DeadCodeEliminationPass must preserve instructions with has_side_effect=True or op=='CALL'.

repo_files.opcodes.py:
"""Bytecode opcode and instruction definitions."""

from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any, Optional


@dataclass
class Instruction:
    op: str  # "CONST", "LOAD", "STORE", "ADD", "CALL", "RETURN"
    arg: Optional[Any] = None
    target_var: Optional[str] = None
    has_side_effect: bool = False
repo_files.basic_block.py:
"""CFG basic block node."""

from typing import List
from opcodes import Instruction


class BasicBlock:
    def __init__(self, block_id: str):
        self.block_id = block_id
        self.instructions: List[Instruction] = []
        self.predecessors: List["BasicBlock"] = []
        self.successors: List["BasicBlock"] = []

tests.test_jit_dce.py:
from basic_block import BasicBlock
from opcodes import Instruction
from optimizer import JITOptimizer


def test_pure_dead_stores_eliminated():
    bb = BasicBlock("b1")
    bb.instructions = [
        Instruction("CONST", 10, target_var="unused_x"),
        Instruction("CONST", 20, target_var="y"),
        Instruction("RETURN", arg="y"),
    ]
    opt = JITOptimizer()
    opt.run(bb)
    ops = [(i.op, i.target_var) for i in bb.instructions]
    assert ops == [("CONST", "y"), ("RETURN", None)]


def test_function_calls_with_side_effects_preserved():
    bb = BasicBlock("b2")
    bb.instructions = [
        Instruction("CALL", "send_email_webhook", target_var="unused_resp", has_side_effect=True),
        Instruction("CONST", 100, target_var="ret_val"),
        Instruction("RETURN", arg="ret_val"),
    ]
    opt = JITOptimizer()
    opt.run(bb)
    # Function call MUST be preserved despite unused return target_var
    assert any(i.op == "CALL" for i in bb.instructions)
    assert len(bb.instructions) == 3


def test_dependency_chain_kept():
    bb = BasicBlock("b3")
    bb.instructions = [
        Instruction("CONST", 5, target_var="a"),
        Instruction("CONST", 10, target_var="b"),
        Instruction("ADD", ("a", "b"), target_var="c"),
        Instruction("RETURN", arg="c"),
    ]
    opt = JITOptimizer()
    opt.run(bb)
    assert len(bb.instructions) == 4
